Die Einsatzkraft tippt unter „Meine Eins: The worker taps "I'm unavailable at short notice" under "My assignments & data" (today or tomorrow, no reason needed). Their shifts are canceled, the office sees the absence immediately on the overview and in the shift schedule, and gets a phone notification. Crewtender suggests suitable free people; tapping a name reschedules the shift.

Finance approval additionally gives access to pricing and company documents.
